svg.aria-label: Figure 1: overview of PFSS. (a) feature scores are normalised into selection probabilities; (b) feature subsets are sampled from them; (c) an ensemble of six classifiers is trained on each subset; (d) accuracy versus subset size and feature selection frequency are reported
